integrity: All-node infinite-family statements follow from the included analytical proof; modular finite-field computations serve only as reproducible finite consistency checks. Independent scientific review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The even-grid obstruction applies to full Hermitian linear tomography, not automatically to pure-state phase retrieval. No uniform conditioning estimates, unequal-grid classification, or infinite-dimensional Gaussian phase-retrieval theorem are established. Relevant recent full-text comparison remains incomplete.
title: Odd-grid completeness and even-grid obstruction for finite Gaussian spectrogram tomography
